theme_strategy: Hybrid Editorial Tech. The core canvas is Light (for legibility, trust, and e-commerce conversion), punctuated by massive Dark Navy blocks (Hero, Final CTA, Footer) to create dramatic entrance/exit tension. Avoids generic AI-slop purple gradients in favor of structural, high-contrast, 'godly' Awwwards-style color blocking.

scale_rules.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase leading-[0.9]

typography.anti_pattern_avoidance: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto for headings. Keep headings tightly tracked to feel like editorial posters.

colors.usage_rules: Orange (#F4622A) is strictly for primary conversion CTAs (Enroll Now). Gold (#F5B400) is used sparingly for highlighting inline text (e.g., 'No Coding'). Navy is for structural weight.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento-style and asymmetrical grids. Avoid perfectly symmetric 3-column bootstrap looks. Use overlapping containers.
spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: Extremely generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. Containers must have internal padding of p-8 or p-12.
spacing_and_layout.borders_and_radii: Rounded card corners (8px - 12px) for UI cards. Use 1px solid borders (border-slate-200) with soft, diffuse shadows (shadow-xl shadow-black/5).

motion_and_interactions.hero_kinetic_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal: Wrap each H1 line in overflow-hidden, and animate y from '100%' to 0 with easing [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] over 0.8s.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: All major sections use Framer Motion whileInView. Initial {opacity: 0, y: 40}, animate to {opacity: 1, y: 0} with slight stagger for children.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Buttons: Hover scaling (scale 1.05) and active press (scale 0.95). Cards: Hover translates up slightly (-translate-y-2) with increased shadow.
motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis wrapper must wrap the entire application for momentum scrolling.

header.layout: Sticky top, z-50. Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 (light theme portion) or dark glass if overlapping hero heavily. Left: Logo. Center: Nav links. Right: Click-to-call + Orange 'Enroll Now' button.

hero.layout: Min-h-[90vh] flex flex-col justify-center relative overflow-hidden.
hero.visuals: Kinetic typography. 3D Parallax background image (abstract blue 3D render) floating with Framer Motion useScroll/useTransform.
hero.content: H1: 'Launch Your Salesforce Career — No Coding, No Experience Needed'. CTAs: Orange 'Enroll Today', Outline Green 'WhatsApp'. Trust Strip anchored to bottom.

editorial_marquee.style: Massive outline text (text-transparent webkit-text-stroke text-7xl font-black). Extremely slow speed. Text: '500+ LEARNERS TRAINED • NO CODING REQUIRED • GUARANTEED PLACEMENT •'

manifesto_why_apexoria.layout: Numbered manifesto chapters (01, 02, 03) in a staggered vertical or asymmetric 2-column grid.
manifesto_why_apexoria.typography: Massive numerals (text-8xl font-black text-slate-100) sitting behind the card content.

featured_course.layout: Highlighted container (bg-neutral_light_gray). Gold text highlight on 'No Coding'. 4-column bento grid for curriculum (Manual, API, Admin, QA Testing with Green Badge).
featured_course.visuals: Mini Project callout box overlapping the grid.

pricing.layout: 4-tier pricing cards. 'Complete Program' scaled up 1.1x with a green accent border and 'Most Popular' badge. Animated SVG step tracker connecting the tiers.

lead_capture.layout: 2-column section. Left: Emotional copy + image. Right: Embedded Shadcn Form inside a pristine white card.
lead_capture.form_details: Fields: Name, Phone, Email, Course (Dropdown), Batch. Submit: Orange Button.

success_stories.layout: Horizontal scrolling carousel or asymmetrical grid.
success_stories.photography: Spotlight/clipped-frame product photography treatment. Grayscale avatars that colorize on hover.
success_stories.metrics: Massive typography numbers for 'Students Placed', 'Hiring Partners'.

placement_support.layout: Process flow. Connected steps with animated dashed SVGs. Resume -> Mock Interviews -> Referrals -> Support.

footer.layout: py-24. Massive Logo mark, Contact info, standard links.

floating_widget.style: Bottom-right, fixed z-50. bg-[#25D366]. Infinite pulse animation.

shadcn_customizations.Card: Remove default borders if creating bento box. Use custom soft shadows.
shadcn_customizations.Button: Override default ring-offset. Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for CTAs. Orange background for primary.
shadcn_customizations.Form: Use Shadcn Input and Select. Style inputs with bg-white, 1px border, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-blue.
shadcn_customizations.Badge: Use for 'Most Popular' and 'Urgent Seats'. Pill-shaped, small uppercase text.

hero_3d_abstract.description: Abstract 3D render in blue hues. Use as parallax background in the dark Hero.

success_student_1.description: Indian student smiling with laptop. Use for testimonial or featured success story.

success_student_2.description: Indian female studying online. Use for testimonial.

team_collaboration.description: Office team meeting tech. Use in Placement Support or Why Apexoria section.

testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing (e.g., data-testid='enroll-now-btn').
instructions_to_main_agent: Execute the 'Awwwards' aesthetic by ensuring exact kinetic text reveals using Framer Motion.
Strictly follow the color palette: use #F4622A (Orange) only for primary conversion CTAs.
Use Cabinet Grotesk/Outfit for massive, tightly-tracked editorial headlines.
Structure the hero section with a dark #0A1F44 background and a subtle parallax effect on the 3D abstract image.
The Featured Course section MUST highlight the 'No Coding' text with the Accent Gold (#F5B400).
Pricing cards should feature an animated SVG connector to imply a step-by-step track.
Do not hallucinate images; strictly use the URLs provided in this JSON.
Apply clipped-frame or spotlight effects to portrait photos (grayscale to color transition on hover).
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing Shadcn components, heavily customized via Tailwind classes to fit the brand.
